font.reason: Geometric/techy variable Kufi gives the machine-computing voice that SF Mono had; Vazir Code looks stretched on Persian prose.

comps.translatedSummary: «نمونه نمایشی قالب حرکت»; noise pool of narrow Persian letters, digits and symbols; lock sweeps right to left.

rtlDecisions.why: Follows reading order; locked prefix grows from the right.
0.6em inline-block cells (never join) inside a per-word ghost box, live layer clipped to the box; locked chars stay inline so the final word joins.
Narrow non-fusing Persian letters, Persian digits, symbols; wide joining letters removed.
Matches the original; glow is symmetric.

concerns: Wide glyphs like گ can still touch a neighbouring cell for a frame; word gaps stay intact thanks to the clip.
lessons: Scramble effects on Persian: symptom, noise letters in adjacent inline spans fuse into a fake word and overflow into word gaps. Cause, joining letters shape across spans. Fix, hopping chars as fixed-width inline-block cells (atomic) from a narrow pool, locked chars inline, per-word ghost box with horizontal clip.
